notes: + Introduced an owner/team-managed early-access cohort for selected Conquest test servers.
+ Added ?installembedemoji and /installembedemoji to install six clean, reusable embed emojis in a server.
+ Added the owner/team-only /changelogs command in bot DMs, alongside its prefix form.
~ Made runtime JSON updates atomic and preserve a recovery copy when a data file is malformed.
- Prevented command aliases from silently overriding another command; ?flip now consistently flips a coin and ?reversetext reverses text.
~ Corrected status and bot-info panels to report prefix and slash command counts separately instead of double-counting commands.
~ Anti-raid verification now retries restoration after temporary API failures and respects manual verification changes.
~ Improved deployment safety by keeping local runtime data and corrupt-file recovery copies out of Bot-Hosting deploys.
~ Expanded setup, anti-raid, anti-spam, permissions, and data-handling documentation.
+ Added owner/team DM tools for server health checks, fresh invite generation, announcements, and release notes.
+ Added server lockdown presets, explicit confirmation, cancellation, and a public lockdown notice.
+ Added reason tracking to command and system disable controls, including ?disableban and ?disableaimode.
~ Improved anti-raid alerts, temporary verification recovery, and per-server spam tracking.
- Fixed missing embed helpers that caused the server count command to fail.
- Fixed AI command loading when a Groq key is missing and clarified the required host environment variable.
~ Updated the bot invite generator to request feature permissions without Administrator.
+ Added ticket-panel setup and restricted ticket closing to the opener and server staff.
